in_sanskrit.name: Jairaj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious Ruler
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jairaj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jai: victory, Raja: ruler. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a powerful name for a boy. It conveys the idea of a brave and victorious leader.

in_marathi.name: Jairaj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jairaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jai: victory, Raja: ruler. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a powerful name for a boy. It conveys the idea of a brave and victorious leader.

in_bengali.name: Jairaj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Victorious Ruler
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jairaj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jai: victory, Raja: ruler. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a powerful name for a boy. It conveys the idea of a brave and victorious leader.
